_note: Release contract (T0.6). release.yml publishes `release.version` once: when CI is green on main and the tag v<version> does not exist yet, and only if app/build.gradle carries the same versionName/versionCode. null = nothing to release. Asset names end with the version (owner, 2026-10-12): `{version}` in `assets` is the app versionName; README links to the releases/latest page. `fully_tested: false` adds the 'not fully tested yet' line to the notes (INBOX #3: intermediate releases before the one full test pass).

release.notes_extra:
New: crash reports, app statistics and an optional account (Firebase). One switch in Settings -> VidChain fallbacks ("Send crash reports and app statistics", on by default) turns every report and statistic on or off; for the first period the reports are detailed (every step VidChain takes goes along with a report, failed downloads and errors are reported too). Nothing sent carries cookies, logins, tokens, e-mail addresses, file names or video addresses, and the advertising ID is not collected. The optional account (e-mail + password, or Google) keeps a small profile only its owner can read; downloads never need an account.

| | 1.2.1 | 1.3.0 |
|---|---|---|
| Crash reports | only on the phone (crash screen) | also sent to the developer (switch, on by default) |
| App statistics | none | Firebase Analytics (same switch, no advertising ID) |
| Account | none | optional: e-mail + password or Google |
| APK size (arm64) | 110.8 MB | 121.7 MB (Firebase) |

Checked on the Android 11 test phone: a test crash and an error report reached Firebase; e-mail sign-up, Google sign-in and sign-out work; the profile is written and updated. Full list: CHANGELOG.md.

methods_per_abi._note: Fallback methods per ABI (Q8 = A: new natives on 64-bit only). CI and release.yml check every APK against this with tools/release/method_matrix.py; the universal APK carries each ABI's set.

method_natives._note: native libraries a method runs in lib/<abi>/ (S, W and H hand media streams to yt-dlp; ffmpeg merges and remuxes); methods not listed run on every ABI (Java/Kotlin or WebView)
